name: 鼓楼
experience_value: Works less as a standalone monument and more as a connector between old-city scale and younger street energy.
Useful when the route needs a hinge between hutong texture, snacks, small shops, and evening movement.
Helps student and solo routes feel urban and lived-in rather than purely ceremonial.
avoid_when: the route already has too many connector nodes and needs a stronger destination-level anchor
the traveler only has one landmark-heavy first-visit day and cannot spend route budget on transition texture
the day is optimized for low-crowd calm rather than lively street energy
